description: This file defines the SystemUserController class in the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes a user service trait to prepare a Vue component for a system user list, specifically setting 'unselectable-ids' property with data fetched from the user service.

classes.name: SystemUserController
classes.description: Controller for managing system user-related views, sets up Vue component with data such as unselectable user IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering by adding the 'unselectable-ids' property with data retrieved from the user service.
